standards.body: One clean standalone PNG per orthographic view. True T-pose, short horizontal mitten arms, no equipment, no straps, no scarf, no manufactured antenna, no hats. Organic crown is body identity. Uniform light cool gray background. Match front identity exactly across views; no perspective/3-quarter. Plain back, no holes or accessory shadows. Side views are true anatomical profiles: right shows HIS right side, faces image-right; left shows HIS left side, faces image-left. Arms extend perpendicular to side view and are foreshortened, not rotated into a three-quarter pose. Same physical scale and neutral pose.
standards.backpack: One standalone detachable backpack ONLY, including own mounting harness and articulated antenna, no wearer/head/limbs/scarf/hat. Four consistent orthographic views. FRONT means the contact side facing wearer's spine/face-direction (shows harness), BACK means the decorated outward speaker face; back.png is primary for Tripo. Right/left use wearer's anatomical sides. No letters/logos, no random unconnected floating fragments, no body baked into loops. Premium enamel, brushed brass, leather, glass. Uniform light cool gray background.
standards.hat: One standalone UNIVERSAL hat/headpiece ONLY; no head/body, no mannequin, no stand. Front is wearer's face direction. Clearly hollow broad rounded underside with adjustable/elastic fit for differently sized round heads. Do not depict hats on any character. Four exact orthographic directions, physical details remain on same sides; front emblem remains only on front. High quality tactile materials. Uniform light cool gray background.
standards.generation: Built-in ImageGen only, one call per individual view; preserve each native original, copy selected final to outputRoot, save actual prompts and output provenance. No Runway, no 3D-generation credits, no Assets changes.
standards.movableTop: MANDATORY for all20 backpacks: clearly separate top assembly above fixed housing, mounted on one plausible swivel/ball-bearing root, rotational clearance, no rigid stays/cables locking it to housing or harness. Unique recognizable top silhouette per hero/variant. Future 3D objects: BackpackRoot fixed, TopPivot single swivel, TopRotor child; both hopping spin and lateral inertial lean supported.
